subject.title: Subagent lifecycle observability + async supervision controls

question: Which core contract should own durable subagent lifecycle receipts and audited cancel, steer, and resume supervision controls now that the metadata-only audit ledger exists?
rationale: The code has several plausible foundations, but the persistence owner, public API shape, read/write authorization, redaction, retention, and idempotency semantics are maintainer product/security choices.

options.title: Extend audit/task ledger
options.body: Use the existing audit and task ledger foundations as the canonical durable record, adding subagent lifecycle events and supervision receipts on top.

options.title: Create subagent lifecycle ledger
options.body: Add a dedicated subagent lifecycle table/API, accepting a narrower but parallel source of truth that must stay synchronized with task and audit records.

options.title: Keep summaries only
options.body: Treat current task/subagent summaries plus metadata audit as sufficient and split remaining UI/channel symptoms into narrower issues.

recommendation.title: Extend audit/task ledger
recommendation.body: Use the existing audit and task ledger foundations as the canonical durable record, adding subagent lifecycle events and supervision receipts on top.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the metadata-audit foundation and appears across recent subagent, state, gateway, and audit history that this decision must coordinate.
